title: Features
seo_title: Jasefly Features — Builder, SDK, ZIP Modules, Access, MCP
seo_description: Real platform capabilities of the Jasefly modular PHP framework: visual Builder, Platform SDK, ZIP packages, Access Layer, MCP, safe updates, and shared-hosting install.

settings.html: Jasefly is an AI-first modular PHP framework. The admin CMS is one product surface on top of PHP core, React frontend, Platform SDK, Access, Builder, MCP, and ZIP module runtime. Below are shipped capabilities — not a wishlist.

settings.title: What ships today
settings.subtitle: Honest inventory of the platform stack.

items.title: Visual Builder
items.body: Compose public pages from widgets; layouts stored as layout_json and rendered by LayoutRenderer.

items.title: ZIP Module Runtime
items.body: Upload → inspect → install/update packages with rollback metadata and quarantine on hard failure.

items.title: Platform SDK
items.body: bootPlatform(PlatformContext) — access, events, HTTP, builder, capabilities, content, and more.

items.title: Universal Access Layer
items.body: One access service for content rules and admin capabilities — fail-closed providers.

items.title: Capabilities & ACL
items.body: registerCapability / canCapability for admin UI and /admin APIs — deny wins on overrides.

items.title: MCP Server
items.body: cms_* tools for site map, content, modules, diagnostics, and managed releases from the agent.

items.title: Safe Updates
items.body: SiteUpdater applies update ZIPs and cleans stale frontend assets on shared hosting.

items.title: Quarantine
items.body: Broken ZIP modules isolate so a bad package does not take down the whole API.

items.title: Shared Hosting Install
items.body: Prebuilt frontend + PHP API on ordinary Apache/MySQL hosting — install ZIP on GitHub releases.

items.title: Self-contained Packages
items.body: Module packages carry their own PHP + FE assets and register through the Platform SDK.

items.title: AI-ready Workflow
items.body: MCP + local clone lets agents work on code and content with controlled tools — not shell root.

items.title: Event-driven Hooks
items.body: events()->publish / subscribe for cross-module coordination without hard coupling.

settings.html: Not claimed as shipped: a public Module Marketplace storefront. ZIP Package Manager exists; a marketplace is exploratory roadmap only.
